sentence: From 2022-02-02 to 2026-11-03 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +37.7% a year (worst drawdown -30.6%) against +43.1% (-30.6%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 87% of stock-weeks. Sharpe ratio difference -0.13 (95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.41, +0.11]): deciding before the open has been **not distinguishable from deciding on the previous close**.
stability: same verdict in 2 of the last 2 runs
